sections.h2: What should I know before selling a house fast in Delray Beach?
sections.html:
Delray Beach is a Palm Beach County city, so your tax bill, deed recording and tax-certificate rules come from county offices. A fast sale here usually depends on three items: the condition of the house, any mortgage payoff, and the property tax calendar.

The city's own history page describes a place that grew from a small farming village to a city of nearly 70,000 residents, with a historic downtown on Atlantic Avenue and older neighborhoods around it. Older homes near downtown can carry deferred maintenance, while newer ones elsewhere in the city tend to need less. Buyers who use mortgages may ask for repairs. Cash buyers often buy as-is.

  • List the house with an agent if you can wait for showings and a lender's timeline.
  • Sell as-is for cash if repairs, a move date or a tax deadline is pressing.
  • Sell to a renovator if the house needs work a mortgage buyer would reject.

sections.h2: How did Delray Beach get its name and shape?
sections.html:
The town was first called Linton, then Delray, and finally Delray Beach after a merger of two municipalities in 1927. The city's timeline traces each step.

Delray Beach name and incorporation timeline from the City of Delray Beach
YearWhat happened
1895Plat of the Town of Linton drawn; Atlantic Avenue platted
1896Florida East Coast Railway completed through town
1898Linton renamed Delray after crop freezes and a land payment default
1911Area west of the canal incorporated as the Town of Delray
1923Area east of the Intracoastal incorporated as the Town of Delray Beach
1927Two towns unite as the City of Delray Beach on May 11
1985Community Redevelopment Agency formed

Source: City of Delray Beach, About Delray Beach.

The split between the mainland and the barrier island explains why Delray still has two distinct feels, a beachside area east of the waterway and inland neighborhoods to the west. The first bridge over the canal was built in 1911 to link them.

sections.h2: Which Delray Beach landmarks affect how a house sells?
sections.html:
Old School Square and Atlantic Avenue anchor the downtown, and houses within walking distance often draw buyers who want that setting. The 1913 school building now houses the Cornell Museum of Art and History, and the 1925 high school building is the Crest Theatre. The city says the Old School Square campus was revitalized in the 1990s.

The city also lists three All-America City awards, in 1993, 2001 and 2017, and says it was the first city in Florida to win it three times. Those details are part of why buyers look at older blocks near downtown.

If your home is in or near a historic area, ask the city's planning staff about any rules for exterior changes before a buyer commits to a renovation plan. A renovation buyer will want to know that early.

sections.h2: When are Palm Beach County property taxes due for a Delray Beach house?
sections.html:
The county tax collector mails more than 600,000 property tax bills by November 1, and they are payable from November 1 through March 31. Property tax turns delinquent on April 1 and then carries penalties and interest.

The Palm Beach County Tax Collector's discount schedule is 4 percent in November, 3 percent in December, 2 percent in January and 1 percent in February, with no discount in March. The early-payment dates that fall on a weekend or holiday move to the next business day.

  • The property appraiser mails the Notice of Proposed Taxes each August.
  • Delinquent tax cannot be paid online, and the office says postmark date is not proof of payment once the tax is delinquent.
  • If you sold the house and the bill still came to you, the tax collector has a Property Sold Form so the bill can be redirected.

The county's property tax page also lists an installment plan and a homestead tax deferral. Ask the office whether you qualify before you list the house.

sections.h2: What does Florida charge on a Delray Beach deed and recording?
sections.html:
The state rate in section 201.02 is 70 cents for each $100 of consideration, and all parties on the deed are liable whichever one agrees to pay. Palm Beach County is not Miami-Dade, so the ordinary statewide rate applies.

The clerk charges $5.00 for the first page and $4.00 for each additional page under section 28.24, plus per page trust fund and technology charges. Spousal homestead deeds where the only consideration is a mortgage, and divorce deeds for the marital home, are listed as exempt.

Lady bird deeds are sometimes used by older owners. A Department of Revenue advisement from October 2020 concluded that one on the facts presented was not subject to documentary stamp tax because the life tenants kept full powers, but it is specific to those facts. Ask a title attorney before relying on it.

sections.h2: How do I choose between a listing and a quick sale in Delray Beach?
sections.html:
Compare the net amount, the time to close and the risk that a deal falls through. A listing can reach more buyers but adds showings, appraisal and loan conditions. A cash sale can close on the date you choose and often skips repair requests.

  1. Get your mortgage payoff in writing.
  2. Check whether property taxes for the current year are paid.
  3. Ask each buyer who pays stamps, title and recording.
  4. Ask for the closing statement ahead of time.

If a foreclosure is pending, remember that the clerk's sale follows final judgment within 20 to 35 days unless the plaintiff agrees to more time.

faqs.q: When did Delray Beach become a city?
faqs.a: The City of Delray Beach was formed on May 11, 1927, when the Town of Delray Beach and the City of Delray united. The two had been incorporated separately, in 1923 and 1911.

faqs.q: What was Delray Beach called before?
faqs.a: It was first Linton, named in 1895 for a congressman in the settlement group. Residents changed it to Delray in 1898 after freezes damaged crops.

faqs.q: When are Palm Beach County property taxes delinquent?
faqs.a: April 1. Bills are payable from November 1 through March 31, and delinquent taxes cannot be paid online.

faqs.q: Is there an early payment discount in Palm Beach County?
faqs.a: Yes: 4 percent in November, 3 percent in December, 2 percent in January and 1 percent in February, with none in March.

faqs.q: Do I pay documentary stamp tax when I sell in Delray Beach?
faqs.a: The contract decides who pays, but all parties are liable. The statewide deed rate is 70 cents per $100 of consideration.
